generation_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original Runelord full body base concept: Siltglass Colony, a hostile mineral organism. A squat asymmetrical cluster of FIVE broad smoky-quartz plates forming a tilted fan-shaped torso, supported on THREE thick articulated clay root legs, with a single narrow amber sensory seam under the central plate. No humanoid face, no arms, no armor, no equipment. Distinct triangle ground-contact footprint. Full silhouette neutral combat pose facing left shallow three-quarter, clean separation of all three legs, generous transparent margins. Use the supplied approved Runelord artwork as a reference for simplified 2D shapes and cel-shaded rendering ONLY, not identity. Make the new character grittier and more serious: tough stylized silhouette, muted colors with selective accents, a few bold signs of wear. Broad clean color shapes, crisp edges and hard-edged cel shadows. Slightly more designed detail, simple surfaces. Palette slate violet, ochre clay, amber seam. Avoid cute mascot expressions, realistic anatomy, painterly rendering, dense grunge, 3D/PBR, gradients, scenery, text, pedestals, shadows outside subject. Genuine transparent alpha. At least 1024 long edge.
